description: Use this only after the person confirms they want to block a number: future faxes from it to the organization are deleted as they arrive, and nobody is emailed. Pass inbound_fax_id to block the number a received fax came from, or number for a number the person gives you. Faxes already in the inbox stay. unblock_sender undoes it. Needs the person to sign in to Faxette.

number.description: A fax number the person gave you, in international format, like +12125550100.

organization.description: The organization's id from get_organizations. Ask the person which one if there are several.

name: block_sender
title: Block a fax number
